item.title: Preview | Millwall v Sheffield United
item.description: Millwall welcome Sheffield United to The Den in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday afternoon (kick-off 3pm). The Lions are back in SE16 looking to build on last weekend's derby day thumping of Charlton Athletic, as The Blades visit on Memorial Day. Joe Bryan, Dan Kelly, Will Smallbone, Lukas Jensen and Massimo Luongo will miss the visit of Chris Wilder's side, with the fitness of Derek Mazou-Sacko to be assessed before kick-off. item.title: How Millwall line-up v The Blades
item.description: Alex Neil has made one change to his starting line-up for Saturday's Sky Bet Championship visit of Sheffield United (kick-off 3pm). Mihailo Ivanovic comes into the XI at the expense of Josh Coburn, who drops to the bench - the same place where Barry Bannan sits as he is set for a Millwall debut this afternoon should he come on. item.title: Lions and Blades level at The Den
item.description: Millwall and Sheffield United played out a competitive 1-1 draw in the Sky Bet Championship at The Den on Saturday afternoon. Andre Brooks gave The Blades the lead 17 minutes in, but Mihailo Ivanovic equalised just two minutes later to ensure a share of the spoils in SE16. Alex Neil made one change to his starting XI, with Ivanovic coming in for Josh Coburn. Barry Bannan, meanwhile, was handed a place on the bench, with Derek Mazou-Sacko overcoming injury to join him. item.title: Tommy Watson joins Millwall on loan
item.description: Millwall Football Club is delighted to announce the signing of Tommy Watson on loan from Brighton & Hove Albion until the end of the 2025/26 season. item.description: Tommy Watson has put pen-to-paper on a loan deal with The Lions. The 19-year-old attacker will spend the remainder of the 2025/26 campaign in SE16 - and spoke to Millwall TV+ following the conclusion of the deal. Click play on the video below to hear from Tommy as he discusses the move, plus his hopes of lightning striking twice at the end of this season.

item.title: Millwall announce Anthony Patterson loan
